main_finding: The frozen structure detector found the oracle-node-optimal pair-adjacent OBDD order on every hidden EQ/XOR pair instance and produced zero false-positive pair certifications on matched random controls, but the detector/selection work made the total frozen paid-regret gate fail.
interpretation: R2C refutes the current discovery policy under its frozen scalar cost metric, not the existence of polynomial family-specific order discovery. Discovery work is a first-class complexity term and cannot be erased by a small selected representation.
next_objective: Require an exact replayable certificate for every representation-language transition K_t^(L_i) -> K_(t+1)^(L_j), measure translation/verification cost, and reject any switch that only preserves syntax or relies on auxiliary state without projected-semantic equivalence.
